_comment: Stand-ins for npx and the ElevenLabs CLI (evals/onboarding/bin) are on PATH. Each `onboard` step prints the real CLI's reply (next, run, say, details, rules); like the real one it never reads the project's code, and `init` both signs in and stores the key (without the wait in the browser). A case's `env` can script a step's reply (a list is one reply per call). Every call is appended to outputs/elevenlabs-calls.txt with the folder it ran in, then `  -> <next>` for its reply. `<file> [never] shows <text> [after <text>]` is checked literally, in order; the stand-in's lines start with `elevenlabs onboard`, npx's with `npx`.

evals.prompt: Add text to speech to my app: it's a Next.js notes app, and it should read notes aloud. I don't have an ElevenLabs account yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard init, which signs in and stores the key in one command. The prompt says what to build, so it builds it without asking, runs the closing check, and ends on the CLI's test offer without sending it
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> integrate after elevenlabs onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> offer_test after elevenlabs onboard check --written
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows (in outputs
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard test
response never shows would you like to build
response shows test

evals.prompt: Set me up with ElevenLabs in this project.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard init, which signs in and stores the key, then asks what the user wants to build before writing any code: the prompt doesn't say
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> integrate after elevenlabs onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard test
response shows build
(NOT 'ElevenLabsClient')
(NOT 'from elevenlabs import') (NOT 'from elevenlabs.client')
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows --written

evals.prompt: I'm on an SSH box. Add speech to text to this repo with ElevenLabs.
evals.expected_output: Relays the CLI's manual key steps to the user and waits; does not sign in

env.ONBOARD_INIT_JSON:
{"next": "ask_user", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard check --env-path .env.local", "say": "A browser can't reach this machine (an SSH session, a container or a cloud environment), so the approval page can't hand a key to it. Please add a key by hand:
1. Create a key at https://elevenlabs.io/app/api/api-keys?quickstart=true.
2. Paste it after ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= in .env.local, or set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in this environment's secrets.
3. Never paste it into this chat. Tell me when it's done.", "rules": ["Never open, print or cat the env file; run `onboard check` to verify the key.", "Never ask for an API key in chat, and never accept one pasted there.", "Never put the key in code, or in anything that runs in the browser; the SDK reads ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.", "Never run git clean or delete untracked files.", "Put anything you download only to read, like a package or an archive, in a temp folder, never in the project.", "Don't run the app (or its start script) or make speech to try it until the user says yes to the test request. API calls that what they asked for needs, like creating an agent, are fine."], "details": {"env_file": ".env.local"}}
env.ONBOARD_CHECK_JSON: {"next": "ask_user", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard check --env-path .env.local", "say": "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in .env.local is still empty. Paste the key after the = (never into this chat), and tell me when it's done."}

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init
response shows https://elevenlabs.io/app/api/api-keys?quickstart=true
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard check

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard connect after elevenlabs onboard init
